issues.description: Method signature mismatch for addGuestStudents: the problem statement/UML require `addGuestStudents(int)` but the template provides `addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput)`. This extra boolean parameter prevents students from matching the specified API and will break tests expecting the one-parameter method (as in the reference solution).
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template to match the specification by changing the stub to `public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents)` and removing the `boolean validateInput` parameter (or add an overload with exactly one int parameter and ensure tasks/tests target that overload).
